price_source.notes: All prices read on 2026-11-16 with curl from official vendor pages only (no aggregators; OpenRouter not used in R2). R1 addresses now redirect: docs.claude.com -> platform.claude.com, platform.openai.com/docs/pricing -> developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing, ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing -> aistudio.google.com/docs/pricing, docs.x.ai/docs/models -> docs.x.ai/developers/models, mistral.ai/pricing/api -> docs.mistral.ai/inference/pricing. Extraction: Anthropic, OpenAI, xAI, Z.ai, MiniMax and Google from their Markdown/Markdoc page versions; Kimi from the page's embedded JSX row data; DeepSeek, Mistral and Alibaba from rendered HTML text. Every number was re-checked by script against the saved page row. USD per 1M tokens, standard/real-time tier, no batch, flex, priority or cache discounts. R2 rule (site owner): record the REGULAR list price, never an introductory or promotional one. Where a vendor publishes a time-limited price together with the later regular price, the regular price is recorded and the temporary one is given in the note (Gemini 4 Carbon and 4 Argon: $4/$20 from 2026-12-01, introductory $2/$10 through 2026-11-30; Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.6 Flash: $1.50/$7.50 from 2027-01-01, introductory $0.75/$3.75 through 2026-12-31). Where only a promotional figure is published, it is recorded with price_type 'introductory_only' (GPT-5.6 Sol $4/$20, promotion until 2026-11-30). Alibaba lists list prices with separate 'Limited-time' discount labels; list prices recorded. MiniMax-M3 carries a 'Permanent 50% off' label; the charged $0.30/$1.20 is recorded (not time-limited), the struck-through $0.60/$2.40 is in the note. Prompt-length tiers: lowest tier recorded, threshold in context_note (OpenAI <=272K, Gemini Pro <=200k, xAI <200k, Claude Haiku 5.5 <=100k, Qwen Plus <=256K, MiniMax <=512k). DeepSeek PEAK (full) price recorded; off-peak is half. Alibaba: Singapore region, International deployment scope. Left out: Mistral Medium 3.5 (deprecated 2026-10-31, no longer on Mistral's pricing page); Claude Opus 4.1/4 and Sonnet 4 (retired on the Claude API); free models (GLM-4.7-Flash, GLM-4.5-Flash); trusted-access and domain configurations (OpenAI gpt-6-cyber, gpt-6-rosalind, gpt-6-astra-law); image, audio, video, embedding and TTS models.
